text:
ron (product): Quick sync: compare table is feeling too noisy — users asking for denser rows but still need clear filter chips and the pinned version affordance to be obvious. Thoughts?
anya (design): Agree. Two proposals: compact mode (tight rows, icon-only performance badges with tooltips) or hybrid (condensed rows + show full badges on hover). Concern: icon-only may reduce discoverability.
sophia (fe): Icon-only OK if hover and focus reveal label. Implementation note: we need to ensure the hover area is large enough for touch laptops. Also chips overflow needs an ellipsis menu, not just wrap.
matt (eng): Chips overflow menu is fine. But compact mode will change DOM density, so virtualization tuning needed. Could be perf regressions if row height varies a lot.
amanda (a11y): From a11y POV: icon-only badges must have accessible names; role=img with aria-label or include sr-only text. For hover reveal, ensure it's keyboard-accessible (focusable) and not only mouse hover.
rahul (data): Quick thought: our perf badges are percentile-based. If we switch to icon-only, we'll lose context. Consider tiny numeric p95 next to icon in compact mode, truncated to 3 chars (e.g., "120ms"). That keeps info density.
anya (design): Good call. I'll try a compact mock with icon + micro-text p95, and a hover panel that shows distribution sparkline + cost estimate.
ron (product): Pin semantics question: should pin be global to model or scoped per route/workspace? Users expect both. Current behavior is ambiguous.
matt (eng): Backend returns pinned_scope: "global" or "route". UX should surface scope and allow users to change it. We'll add an explicit scope dropdown in the pin modal: [Global | Route: /api/translate | Workspace: Team A].
sophia (fe): For the row UI, maybe a small pin indicator; clicking opens a mini-menu to choose scope. Keyboard: Enter opens menu, arrow keys to pick.
amanda (a11y): Ensure pin menu is accessible: role=\"menu\" and trap focus within until explicit close. Announce \"Pin menu opened for {model}\". Also confirm Esc closes and returns focus to the pin button.
rahul (data): If we allow workspace-scoped pins, metrics aggregation must respect that. I'll add a note: analytics tag pinned_scope for dashboard filtering.
anya (design): Filters persistence: should last-used filters be per-user or per-team? Product wants per-user but sales demo wants team defaults. Maybe support both: user override saved locally, team defaults stored server-side.
ron (product): Yes. Server-side team defaults + client-side user overrides. We'll need a small toggle: \"Save as team default\" when saving a filter preset.
matt (eng): Implementation complexity: will need new API endpoints for presets and order. ETA: two sprints.
sophia (fe): I'll prototype filter preset UI. Also request: keyboard shortcut to cycle between compact and comfortable row density (e.g., D). Provide visible indicator when toggled.
amanda (a11y): Shortcut OK if discoverable. Add a help tooltip in the table header: \"Press D to toggle row density\" and ensure it's in the accessible help modal.
deploy-bot: canary/build #2099 passed 1:34 staging.
ron (product): Great. Action list: anya mock compact/hybrid + pin scope menu, sophia prototype keyboard flows & overflow menu, matt infra ticket for presets + pinned_scope, amanda run A11y checklist, rahul add analytics tags. We'll review next Wed. Drop quick links/examples here if you have existing patterns.
